Author: MathDad
Name: Senpan Admin Companion
Description: Serves as an alternative to many of the web-interface functions, allowing staff to operate various systems from within the game.
Punchline: Allows Senpan Tea House staff to use various app services right from the game.
Changelog: The raffle Paid cell now opens a payment dialog carrying the same settlement the website offers - how many tickets a payment covers, and gil waived on it - and reads Paid / Partial / Unpaid. A Details Only raffle no longer offers to sign anyone up. Timed macros gain a Test send that fires once without counting towards the send total, and Reset is now offered whenever there is progress to clear rather than only at the send cap.
